milkyWay.densityEncoding: uint8; 0 = no stars; v>0 -> count = exp(ln(1) + (v-1)/254*(ln(2322)-ln(1)))
milkyWay.bpRpEncoding: uint8; 0 = none; v -> mean BP-RP = v/255*3 mag

hrDiagram.indexing: byte (mi*width + ci): BP-RP = bpRpMin + (ci+0.5)*0.05, M_G = absGMin + (mi+0.5)*0.1
hrDiagram.selection: Gaia DR3, parallax > 5 mas (within 200 pc), parallax_over_error > 10, BP/RP flux S/N > 20, RUWE < 1.4; no extinction correction
